specs.Target Audience: Men, Unisex Adults, Unisex Kids, Unisex Youth, Women

features: A SIZING KIT FOR A FLAWLESS FIT: Finding your perfect fit is a breeze with our convenient Galaxy Ring Sizing Kit; Select your best fit from a variety of sizing options.
NINE DIFFERENT SIZES: Purchase the Sizing Kit, which includes 9 sample rings to try on - find your best fit with sizing kit and then buy the Galaxy Ring.
HOW TO USE THE SIZING KIT: After receiving the Galaxy Ring Sizing Kit, choose a sample ring and wear it for at least 24 hours (including sleep); Check that it’s not too small or too big.

SENSORS SHOULD FACE YOUR PALM: The 3 bumps on the inner part of the sample ring are where the sensors on the actual Galaxy Ring will be; Turn the sample ring so that the sensors are facing towards the palm of your hand.

MAY DIFFER FROM REGULAR RING SIZES: Galaxy Ring sizes may be different from regular ring sizes, so find the right fit with the Sizing Kit and follow the instructions provided; Galaxy Ring sizes range from 5-13 and there are no half sizes.
